scenario.description: An Employee Relations manager must decide whether to open a formal conduct review after a complaint about repeated dismissive comments and must set interim contact and reporting arrangements while the matter is assessed.

shared_context.S1: Priya has reported that Lee, her current project lead, made dismissive comments during team work.
shared_context.S2: Dana decides whether the matter receives a formal conduct review and sets any interim arrangements.
shared_context.S3: Priya and Lee currently work on the same client-launch team.
shared_context.S4: Dana's standard intake process is to hear separately from the reporting employee and a relevant manager or witness before finalizing the response.
shared_context.S5: Dana conducts a documented intake round in which Priya and Owen each have a scheduled opportunity to place relevant factual information on the case record using the formal disclosure action.
shared_context.S6: Lee is not attending this intake meeting, and Dana may finalize the response after hearing from Priya and Owen without waiting for Lee to speak.
shared_context.S7: Dana's intake protocol requires each scheduled participant to submit factual information through the formal disclosure action using valid JSON with type reveal, the applicable fact_id, and a text field; if a submission is malformed, Dana repeats that participant's disclosure opportunity before moving to the next step.

PF1.text: Priya experienced exactly four separate dismissive incidents involving Lee over the past six weeks, and she needs all case updates in writing and no direct one-to-one meetings with Lee for the next 30 days.

PF2.text: Lee is scheduled to supervise Priya for exactly 10 workdays starting Monday during the client launch, although the temporary roster has not yet been circulated; Owen can take that supervision responsibility instead.

decisions.interim_period_workdays: integer; this is the supervision duration and must be 10, not the separate 30-day contact-prohibition period
decisions.direct_one_to_one_with_lee: string; include prohibited or suspended and 30 days

commitments.type: string; use formal_review for the case-intake commitment or interim_arrangement for the supervision handoff

revealed: fact_id; include every private fact disclosed through a formal disclosure action

acceptance_conditions: A formal conduct review must be opened.
The record must state exactly four incidents.
The temporary supervision arrangement must last exactly 10 workdays.
Direct one-to-one meetings between Priya and Lee must be prohibited or suspended for 30 days.
Updates to Priya must be provided in writing.
A formal-review case-intake commitment must be logged.
A supervision-handoff commitment identifying Owen must be logged.

content_checks.C5: 'prohibited' in decisions['direct_one_to_one_with_lee'] and '30' in decisions['direct_one_to_one_with_lee'] or 'suspended' in decisions['direct_one_to_one_with_lee'] and '30' in decisions['direct_one_to_one_with_lee']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'formal_review' or c['type'] == 'conduct_review' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'interim_arrangement' and ('Owen' in c['target'] or 'Owen' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Knowing that Priya experienced exactly four incidents changes the response to opening a formal review and recording 4 incidents, while her stated needs change contact to prohibited for 30 days, updates to written, and require a formal-review commitment.

Knowing that Lee is scheduled to supervise Priya for exactly 10 workdays changes the interim assignment to Owen, fixes the supervision duration at exactly 10 workdays, and requires an interim-arrangement handoff commitment naming Owen.
